faults.title: Electrical faults with driver aids (Mk4)
faults.description: In Auto Express's 2022 Driver Power survey, 13.5% of 2020-on Mk4 Yaris owners reported a fault. The most common were electrical, especially with the driver-assistance and active safety systems.

faults.title: ESP software recall (Mk4)
faults.description: Nearly 20,000 Mk4 cars made between July 2020 and April 2021 were recalled because faulty software could stop the stability control (ESP) working properly. A software update fixes it.

faults.title: Corrosion behind rear number plate trim (Mk3)
faults.description: On the 2011-2020 Mk3, the trim around the rear number plate can react with the tailgate and cause corrosion. Auto Express says dealers know about it.

faults.title: Multidrive CVT less reliable than manual (Mk3)
faults.description: Auto Express says the Mk3's Multidrive CVT automatic divides owners and is less reliable than the manual gearbox.

faults.title: Mk3 recalls: brakes, steering, hubs
faults.description: The Mk3 had eight recalls, including brake fluid leaks, power steering failure, turbo oil leaks, rear hubs working loose and a suspension failure campaign in 2016. Check recall work on any Mk3.
